integrity: All assertions are derived from the written combinatorial proof. One previous large-minimum-part result covers the high-size specialization; originality is claimed for a complete all-profile four-part classification, including small parts. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact optimum cardinality for four nonempty parts only; no enumeration of maximum partitions and no theorem for arbitrary numbers of parts. Historical priority provisional. Finite checks are not a proof of all parameter values.
title: Exact global coalition numbers for complete four-partite graphs
